# HEIC preview decoder

Unmodified `heic-to` 1.6.7, `dist/next/heic-to.js`, from the npm release.
Source: https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to/tree/v1.6.7
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/heic-to/-/heic-to-1.6.7.tgz
License: LGPL-3.0; see LICENSE and upstream sources for the bundled libheif / libde265 components.
This standalone ES module is loaded only when native image decoding fails for HEIC/HEIF.
It runs decoding in a browser worker. Photo bytes never go to a conversion service.
